svg.title: Chat hello
svg.desc: Second take on the empty AI chat: the companion waves next to a speech bubble in which hello is typed, deleted and retyped in several languages - Hello, Hallo, Szia, こんにちは, Bonjour, Ciao.

g.font-family: 'Instrument Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif
